provider.secretSource: process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY only (read at call time; never logged, never written to disk)
localSecretFiles: config/live.local.json (exists? false in this checkout; gitignored, carries DingTalk webhook/secret only)

model.MODEL_PROVIDER_REPORTED: the model field sent in the request payload is exactly getModel()
model.MODEL_ALIAS_NORMALIZATION: NONE - there is no alias table anywhere
model.hardEqualityGuard: live/4hBiasV3.js:30-32 rejects the refresh with V3_MODEL_CONFIG_MISMATCH when getModel() !== semanticContract.MODEL
model.consequenceOfChangingModelEnv: with a different DEEPSEEK_MODEL value the service never calls the LLM and publishes PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE rather than silently using another model

prompt.PROMPT_HASH: sha256 of the full prompt template, computed at module load (line 59)
prompt.legacyPromptHashRetained: 4hBiasSemanticV3.LEGACY_V2_PROMPT_HASH is exported so V2-era records can never be mistaken for V3 records
prompt.userPromptContent: the canonical input object serialized with JSON.stringify(input, null, 2); see INPUT_SCHEMA

INPUT_SCHEMA.enforcement: validateInput uses exactKeys() so any extra or missing field raises V3_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID / V3_FACT_SCHEMA_INVALID
INPUT_SCHEMA.typeRules: symbol string; timeframe must equal '4h'; closedAt finite number; the five numeric facts finite numbers; structureDirection one of UP|DOWN|NEUTRAL

OUTPUT_SCHEMA.enforcement: validateOutput exactKeys() plus enum checks; summary must be a non-empty string; conflicts must be a string

requestParameters.temperatureSource: hard-coded 0 in defaultRequestSemantic; the client would otherwise read DEEPSEEK_TEMPERATURE (default 0)
requestParameters.thinking: { type: 'disabled' } (comment records that deepseek-v4-flash thinking mode produced ~22K completion tokens and gateway empty-200 timeouts)
requestParameters.maxAttempts: 0 in the bias call path (no retry), i.e. a single attempt per MISS

evidence: buildUserPrompt serializes exactly buildInput(factSet), which is the 4-field object built from factSet
test 16 asserts the serialized semantic input matches /raw|ohlc|candle|bars6|bars12|EQL|EQH|FVG|WATCH|persistence|transition|kalman/i is absent
bias/4hBiasFactsV3.js never passes candles into the semantic layer

promptBehaviouralConstraints: sign contributes to Direction, magnitude contributes to Strength
ADX14 contributes to Strength only and has no direction
signedMoveAtr24 and signedEfficiency24 are one correlated Delivery family and must not be double-counted
conflict must be summarized honestly; NO_PRIORITY must not be avoided artificially
no hard thresholds, no weighted voting, no composite scores
no future price, next candle, continuation, reversal, outcome or profitability
no trading advice, entries, targets, WATCH decisions or notification decisions
no candlestick patterns, bodies, wicks, support/resistance, chart geometry or unseen indicators

deepSeekRole.classification: B - the LLM reads deterministic facts and performs semantic synthesis
deepSeekRole.notes: the prompt explicitly forbids prediction and forbids inventing evidence; the model compresses six deterministic facts into one bias triple plus prose
